status: Physiology calibration and model adequacy checks; confirmatory functional experiment not yet frozen.
goal: Experimentally grounded CA2-centered circuit experiment with matched interventions and reproducible results
primary_question: Under controlled cortical and hippocampal input, what does CA2 contribute to information transmission to CA1?
task: Present distinct rate-matched afferent spike patterns under different timing and distractor conditions; quantify downstream identity discriminability and response timing. No familiarity label is supplied and identity transfer is not called social recognition memory.

circuit.core: Five CA2 types from fresh Hippocampome export
circuit.upstream: Controlled EC and CA3 afferent spikes; explicit upstream populations only if required by feedback hypothesis
circuit.downstream: Source-constrained CA1 readout with alternative inputs retained; dorsal/ventral specificity must be audited
circuit.boundary: No thalamus or basal ganglia initially; add a specific pathway when an unmet hypothesis requires it

stages: Reproduce original driver and audit fresh export and defaults
Check numerical sensitivity and baseline behavior with fresh parameters
Extract physiological response targets and afferent/output parameters; reject unjustified anatomical mapping
Calibrate only on physiological training targets, freeze parameters and document calibrated versus measured versus default values
Run identity-transfer task with paired input and connectivity seeds across intact CA2, interrupted CA2 output, and an activity-matched scrambled CA2 output control
Test held-out input patterns and timings with a frozen readout; repeat across independent network seeds
Run parameter and numerical sensitivity; compare with physiological targets not used for calibration
Deliver plots, effect sizes, uncertainty, negative results, configuration hashes, execution logs and bounded conclusions
primary_measure: CA1 identity decoder balanced accuracy on held-out trials; labels correspond only to input identity
controls: Same input events and network seed across interventions
Preserve topology and parameter draws when interrupting CA2 output
Shuffled output control matched for rate; avoid interpreting generic loss of drive as specific information processing
Label-permutation null; trial-level data split; no train/test leakage
Network seeds are replicates; neurons or time bins are not independent animal replicates
Calibration data are not counted as independent validation
Negative or null intervention outcomes are valid results
replication_note: Five seeds are a pilot target, not a power calculation; assess uncertainty and expand before broad conclusions.

sources.title: Strong CA2 Pyramidal Neuron Synapses Define a Powerful Disynaptic Cortico-Hippocampal Loop
sources.use: Figures3 and5 single-pulse excitatory calibration; Figure3 CA3 inhibition calibration; held-out train response checks. MEC LII is not the LIII pathway in Figures2 or9.

sources.title: A direct lateral entorhinal cortex to hippocampal CA2 circuit conveys social information required for social memory
sources.use: Mouse LEC/MEC physiology and pathway interventions. Raw data available from lead contact on request; unavailable locally. Paper-level summary is not raw spike input.

sources.title: A hippocampal circuit linking dorsal CA2 to ventral CA1 critical for social memory dynamics
sources.use: Supports output-pathway relevance; generic CA1 must not be called ventral CA1 without parameters

claim_limits: A synthetic pattern task tests circuit information transmission, not animal recognition or behavior
Extending to social memory requires an explicit source-constrained learning mechanism and delay protocol
Mixed rodent parameter provenance does not constitute matched validation in mice
A point-neuron model cannot independently validate dendritic integration mechanisms
Scientific success means a reproducible and defensible answer, not a positive outcome

pilot_implementation.input: MEC LII Stellate afferents from selected export; does not stand in for LEC
pilot_implementation.core: Full fresh-export CA2 network plus prescribed MEC and CA3 spikes
pilot_implementation.downstream: CA1 feedforward target assay; 128 pyramidal targets and selected full-count inhibitory populations
pilot_implementation.CA2_intervention: Replay recorded pyramidal output intact, deleted, or independently permuted in cell identity for each trial; same spike times in intact and scrambled controls
pilot_implementation.limitations: Open-loop afferents and target assay omit region feedback. Synthetic identities and pulse protocol do not implement social recognition, LIII dendritic physiology, or a matched behavioral experiment.
pilot_implementation.next_gate: Inspect pilot evoked voltages and transmission before selecting confirmatory stimuli; freeze final stimuli, parameters and metrics before independent-seed testing.

pilot_findings.history: 300ms-spaced trials have severe carryover and are excluded from confirmatory identity inference. Subsequent task trials must reset simulator state.
pilot_findings.physiology: Default source-constrained model has weak aggregate CA3 inhibition after matching single-pulse excitation. Test isolated reversal and aggregate inhibitory gain; document fits, assumptions and independent validation.
